issues.description: image.tobytes() with format='RGB' breaks for PNG returns in RGBA, palette, or grayscale modes
issues.detail: Gemini returns PNG which PIL opens in whatever mode the source uses (RGBA, P, L). Calling tobytes() without convert('RGB') while declaring format='RGB' yields a buffer whose size and layout disagree with the declared format. Downstream renderers will get garbled pixels or crash. Fix with image.convert('RGB').tobytes() or propagate image.mode.

issues.description: Module-import monkey-patch of genai._api_client.READ_BUFFER_SIZE mutates third-party private global state
issues.detail: Reaching into a private underscore-prefixed attribute of google-genai at import time mutates global state for every consumer in the process, not just GoogleLLMService. The author labels it a 'temporary hack' but ships it unconditionally. Use the SDK's public HttpOptions surface, pin the dep, or file upstream — not module-level mutation.

issues.description: Image-model detection via substring 'image' in model name is fragile
issues.detail: The predicate `'image' in self._model_name` misfires for any future model whose name contains the substring (imagen, vision-image-understanding, image-edit), silently disabling thinking budget. Replace with an explicit capability flag or named predicate like is_image_generation_model() so the invariant is documented and testable.

issues.description: Default model change from gemini-2.0-flash to gemini-2.5-flash is a silent behavior shift bundled into a feature PR
issues.detail: Callers relying on the default get different latency, cost, and thinking-budget behavior on upgrade. The CHANGELOG notes it but no deprecation path exists and it does not belong in the same patch as the image-generation feature. Split into a separate PR and flag as a breaking default.

issues.description: Emitting OutputImageRawFrame from GoogleLLMService extends the service postcondition without documentation
issues.detail: The supertype contract is text+tool-call streaming. Adding an image-frame branch mid-stream strengthens what downstream pipelines must accept without restating the contract or specifying frame ordering relative to LLMTextFrame and aggregator boundaries. Document which models produce image frames and what ordering guarantees hold.

issues.description: No tests cover the new inline_data image-emission branch
issues.detail: The new elif branch ships without a unit test feeding a synthetic inline_data part and asserting an OutputImageRawFrame with correct size and mode. Such a test would have caught the RGB/RGBA bug. Add coverage and consider error handling for malformed PIL inputs so one bad part does not abort the whole stream.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on NEEDS-WORK. Two P0 bugs block merge: image.tobytes() declares RGB without converting from PIL's actual mode, producing malformed buffers for the RGBA/P/L outputs Gemini commonly returns; and a module-import-time monkey-patch of google-genai's private READ_BUFFER_SIZE mutates global SDK state for every consumer. Three P1 concerns follow: substring-based image-model detection that will lie on future model names, a silent default-model bump bundled into a feature PR, and an undocumented extension of the LLM service's frame-output contract. The new branch also ships without tests or error handling for malformed inputs.
